questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: What is the purpose of a scale factor smaller than 1:1?
options: Represent a larger object in reduced size

questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: What is the main purpose of a freehand break line?
options: Indicate a shortened or interrupted portion of an object

questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: What is an ellipse's key geometric definition?
options: The sum of distances from two foci is constant

questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: What does an orthographic projector represent?
options: A line of sight perpendicular to the projection plane

questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: When is an auxiliary view especially useful?
options: When an inclined surface's true shape is not clear in principal views

questions.text: In an engineering drawing assessment, the projection or convention must satisfy this geometric condition: Why must the projection convention be identified?
options: Readers need to interpret view placement correctly
